_about: The demo video's one source: what is on screen, for how long, and the caption of each shot. The caption is also the voice line (scripts/video-make.py speaks it with a few pronunciation rules, below).
Hashes, explorer URLs, block numbers, block times and contract addresses are never typed here: they come from records/<deployment>-<run>.json and deployments/<deployment>.json.

Every number in a caption, label or end-card line must be one of the numbers of that shot's evidence; each evidence item is read from README.md word for word, or from a JSON file in records/ or status/, or from docs/config.js (scripts/video-check.py).
seconds is the planned length; a shot grows when its voice line is longer. A realtime shot is never cut: it plays at the speed it was captured.
track1.enabled switches every shot to its ifTrack1 variant. While a {{...}} placeholder is left in an active shot, the check fails.
